dataList.content:
Some time later...
不久之后……

Phew, that's a relief... At least it wasn't indestructible.
还好……至少攻击能够摧毁它。
dataList.place:
L Corp. HQ Training Team Lobby
脑叶公司本部 培训部大厅

dataList.content:
A rubble of broken stones lay about the exhausted Sinners' feet.
气喘吁吁的罪人们脚边堆满了碎石。

But that didn't last long.
但没过多久……

I see... It fades away to naught.
果然……消失了。

Yes. While the entity took the form of a stone stele, an object commonly composed of inorganic matter, it is likely that its existence itself is perceived as a religious artifact in certain indeterminate locales.
是的。虽然其从外形来看显然是由无机物构成的石制品，但其本身在某些地方似乎被视为一种宗教类实体。

Mm~ True. That giant object did suddenly appear out of thin air before dropping right in front of us.
嗯~确实呢，毕竟那么大的物体突然从什么都没有的天花板上出现然后掉了下来。

The stele, which had once threatened the Sinners with its tentacles, soon disappeared from our sight like it never existed.
那伸出触手威慑罪人们的巨大石碑顷刻已经消失得无影无踪。

If Faust hadn't pushed me into the hallway just in time, I'd have been...
如果……那时浮士德没把我推到走廊上的话。

Dante!
但丁！

WHAM!
嘭！

<We would've all died forever if that thing had crushed me, too...>
<要是连我都被压碎了，那一切可全完了……>

We were not crushed by the stele, to be exact. The real issue was the shockwave that came after the crash.
严格来说，石碑本身并不是问题所在。其降下之后产生的冲击波才是关键。

I thought I slipped away in time, but... I had no idea the shockwave would be so deadly.
我靠直觉躲开了那块石头……但没想到那东西威力那么大……

<We're going to have to find a way to deal with that shockwave somehow, or it'll be too risky to continue with our Walpurgis Night expedition.>
<……如果我们不能应对那冲击波，这次瓦尔普吉斯之夜就很难继续探索下去了吧？>

I'm not saying that I'm scared of the pain I have to go through when reviving the Sinners. Which really, really hurts, of course, especially when it's twelvefold, but...
我并不是害怕把罪人们复原。当然，要承受12人份还是非常痛苦的……

... I'm not sure if I want to ask them to repeatedly run a mission that's guaranteed to kill them in the end.
但是，要是我知道每次进入后门，罪人们的死亡就会不断重演的话，我是说不出“继续吧”这句话的。

Moreover, we don't even know if whatever we'll find here will be worth all the trouble.
我们甚至不确定那里真的有东西值得我们这么做。

According to the information given, it is said that Ordeals cannot occur in immediate succession...
根据目前所有的情报来看，似乎不应该连续出现两次考验……

... They can't occur right after one another...? What, did the giant piece of rock have nothin' to do with an Ordeal, then?
连续……？你是说那块破石头跟黎明什么的考验没关系吗？

Yes, it was indeed an Ordeal of Violet. However, this was... the Noon of Violet.
这确实也是紫罗兰的考验。但……这一定是正午考验。

Ordeals of the Noon are a degree higher than Ordeals of the Dawn, which we already have experience with.
这是与已经历过的黎明相比，更高一级的考验。

Faust's brows were frowning at a nigh-imperceptible angle; she was sighing even as she relayed that information to us, clearly perturbed by something.
浮士德微微叹了口气，皱了皱眉，似乎在说这句话时还有什么想不通的事情。

... I suddenly recalled what Faust speculated back at the WARP train: that the Gesellschaft may have made a purposeful omission.
……在WARP列车上听到的“有意的遗漏”一词突然划过我的脑海。

<You think this is the Gesellschaft withholding information from you again?>
<难道说，这次又是Gesellschaft出了问题吗？>

There is no evidence to say for certain. They did not withhold the information regarding the Ordeal of Noon; thus, a more likely explanation is that this was merely a manifestation of a rare possibility.
没有确切的证据。由于对于正午考验的情报均未被封锁，所以更有可能只是展现出了一种罕见的可能性。

... Yet your suggestion does concern me.
……但，这确实令人担忧。

If it was indeed a manifestation of a rare possibility, then we must seek for clues in this Walpurgis Night that may point us to an explanation.
但如果这只是一种罕见的可能性，那么我们就更要在此次瓦尔普吉斯之夜中寻找线索了。

<So... should we explore further?>
<我们要继续探索吗？>

But—
但……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Hello, everyone! Can you hear me...?
啊啊，员工们，听得到吗……？

A loud buzz, crackle, and an unfamiliar voice broke through the awkward silence we were meandering in.
在我们进退两难的时候，突然传来一道夹杂着嗞嗞声的、我从未听到过的声音。

Blimey! Who said that?!
什么情况？谁在说话？

Ooh! I hearken unto thee!!!
哦哦！听得到哟！！

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Oh... I guess I can't hear your answers anyway.
啊……反正我就算问了，也听不到回答吧。

Ahem, ahem. Ignore what I just said. Hello, this is Hod from the Training Team speaking!
嗯哼，忘了我刚才说的吧。这里是培训部的Hod！
dataList.title:
Training Team Sephirah
培训部 Sephirah

dataList.content:
Mm. It appears that the Sephirah 'Hod', whose name we first learned of in the earlier document, is the one speaking to us.
嗯。在之前的文件中看到过，说话的似乎是一位叫作Hod的Sephirah。

Aha... so this is her voice, huh?
啊哈……所以她的声音是这样的？

Gotta say, this is kinda what we all expected her to sound, right?
跟想象中的形象还挺相符……的吧？

We are all investigating how and why an Ordeal of Noon occurred immediately after the Dawn.
目前对于连续发生黎明与正午考验的情况，Sephirah方面也正在展开调查。
dataList.title:
Training Team Sephirah
培训部 Sephirah

dataList.content:
I understand that an unfamiliar situation like this may cause a sense of alarm and anxiety. But there's nothing to worry about as long as you remember the instructions under the Exception #40-AA Measure, which I made sure to mention in every training session!
因为不合常理所以大家都很恐慌吧。不过只要你们还记得我在常规训练中提到过的第40-AA条的例外情况处理方法就没什么好担心的了！
dataList.title:
Training Team Sephirah
培训部 Sephirah

dataList.content:
Exception #40-AA...? Just how many exceptions did she come up with...?
40……？AA？例外情况到底有多少啊……？

She must be a leader with a very hands-on approach to team management. Commanders who are overprotective of their personnel often make such mistakes.
是会严格管理部下的类型吗。过度保护部下的指挥官经常会犯这种错误。

G-guys, I don't think it's time to share our first impressions...! We don't know what measure she's talking about! At this rate, we'll get—
对、对她的第一印象现在并不重要吧……？我们不知道她说的那个方法是什么啊！这样下去——

Oh.
啊。

There was a dull 'thwick' just as Sinclair began to air his concerns.
在辛克莱忧心忡忡地说话时，不知从何处又传来了“砰”一声响。

Uh, d-d-did-did I just get... shot...?!
呃，我……我……被枪击了吗？！

You there, at the lobby... You've been dozing off during our drills, haven't you?
在大厅里的那位……你又在培训时打盹了吧？
dataList.title:
Training Team Sephirah
培训部 Sephirah

dataList.content:
I'm pretty sure I explained that in outlier cases like these, we'll be firing Physical Intervention Shield bullets we share with the middle layer...
我很确定我说过，这种例外情况处理方法中包括向员工发射我们和中层共享的物理屏蔽力场……
dataList.title:
Training Team Sephirah
培训部 Sephirah

dataList.content:
So why are you acting all surprised like you've never been shot before...? Haah...
为什么你慌得像第一次被击中一样啊……唉……
dataList.title:
Training Team Sephirah
培训部 Sephirah

dataList.content:
Shield... bullets...?
屏蔽力场……吗？

<Huh, that 'bullet' does look kinda familiar, actually...>
<这么说来，好像是在哪里见过……>

We carefully approached Sinclair to take a closer look at where the projectile hit him.
我和罪人们心有余悸地缓缓接近辛克莱中弹的部位。

Oh hey, I recognize this. This looks just like the decay ampule...
啊，这不是那个吗。K公司的……

... that almost melted me into a puddle back at K Corp. Eugh, I'm getting unpleasant goosebumps just from thinking about it.
看着跟把我融化成一摊的那些安瓿注射弹……很像啊。呃，想想就让我毛骨悚然。

You were totally badass though, Ishy~ Jumping right in front of Dante, taking the bullets for them and everything!
但是当时相当帅啊，以实~啪地一下闪到但丁面前，挡下了一切！

Hah, then she went ahead and hurled a bloody harpoon into Clockhead's shoulder herself only a few months later.
嘿。然后过了几个月又拿着捕鲸枪亲手刺穿了钟表头的肩膀。

Heh. Like a good circular narrative structure.
呵。首尾呼应。

Okay, you smartasses...
你们这些家伙……

It is not a K Corp. ampule. While it is true that K Corp.'s technology was used to regenerate its employees, a barrier field like this fundamentally differs from the type of technology used by K Corp.
这并非K公司的安瓿。尽管脑叶公司确实为员工的再生恢复使用了K公司的技术。但这种屏蔽力场的概念并不存在于K公司所使用的技术类型之内。

... It is said that Lobotomy Corporation maintained collaborative relationships with other Wings, including K Corp. Through the said collaborations, they obtained bullets and ampules of diverse functionalities useful for the workings of this company.
……据说，过去脑叶公司长期以来与包括K公司在内的复数翼保持着合作关系。通过这些合作，他们获得了有助于公司运作的各种子弹和安瓿。

It appears that this Shield bullet is a result of one such partnership.
这些屏蔽力场子弹，想必也是合作成果之一。

Wait, then this bullet will...
那，被这个击中的话……

It is said that this bullet can partially negate physical damage... which is also known as 'RED damage' in Lobotomy Corporation terminology.
物理伤害……用脑叶公司所使用的术语来说，就是能够起到抵御一定量红色伤害的作用。

It will likely shield us from the shockwave created by the stele as well.
它应该可以承受住石碑降下后带来的冲击波。

We'll have a counseling session later about your lack of focus during training... For now, please try to suppress this Ordeal of Noon as soon as possible.
关于不认真参与培训的问题，我们之后再谈……总之，现在请尽快镇压正午考验。
dataList.title:
Training Team Sephirah
培训部 Sephirah

dataList.content:
I'll give everyone a Physical Intervention Shield, so let's try to take care of this Ordeal with as few casualties as possible!
我会给大家提供屏蔽力场，一起尽量不受伤地镇压此次考验吧！
dataList.title:
Training Team Sephirah
培训部 Sephirah

dataList.content:
Dante, let us...
但丁，我们……

<... Oh, right. Let's get a move on and deal with the other steles as well.>
<……啊，嗯。我们来处理掉剩下的石碑吧。>

Indeed. It would be preferable if we returned after confirming the destruction of steles in other areas as well.
明白。我们最好先确认其他区域的石碑也已经处理完毕再返回。

We will have to visit Lobotomy Corporation Headquarters of different possibilities as well; we will make use of the Sephirah and the Shield as soon as we are able then.
由于我们有必要访问其他可能性中的脑叶公司本部，所以届时一开始就活用Sephirah和屏蔽力场比较好。

<Mm... good idea.>
<嗯……好主意。>

Thanks to the unexpected support from a Sephirah, we were able to explore further through the Walpurgis Night.
多亏了Sephirah突然的帮助，我们才得以照原计划更加深入地探索瓦尔普吉斯之夜。

... All those trainings were for their own good. Is that so hard to understand...?
……我这么做都是为了他们好，为什么每个人都不理解呢……
dataList.title:
Training Team Sephirah
培训部 Sephirah

dataList.content:
It was just that... I couldn't help but think back to Hod's last few utterances that managed to slip through the static.
但……在奔向其他部门时，Hod混杂着杂音的喃喃自语令我感到在意。

It made me wonder what really went down here, at the Headquarters of Lobotomy Corporation.
这家公司……在脑叶公司本部，究竟发生了些什么。
